subject: Regional assertions & evidence routing for ISO / FedRAMP readiness
messages:
From: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@auditops.com>
To: Hiro Tanaka <hiro.tanaka@redwood.ai>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Clarify scope and regional assertions for upcoming FedRAMP/ISO readiness

Hi Hiro —

Thanks for taking this on. We're preparing the scoping worksheet ahead of the readiness assessment for EdgeBank and had a couple of specific asks so we can build a clean evidence plan:

1) Regional assertions: which controls (encryption at rest, logging/retention, key management, data residency) have per-region assertions vs a single global assertion? EdgeBank needs evidence that eu-west-1 and us-west-2 are treated equivalently for certain cryptographic controls.

2) Evidence locations: where should we request snapshots / artifacts for sampling? (S3 buckets, KMS CMKs, CloudTrail snapshots, app logs). Do you have a mapping of control -> store/location per region?

3) SIG/CAIQ mapping: will you be able to provide a CAIQ export and a SIG mapping scoped to the service boundary we discussed (Hosted API + Dedicated + Private VPC)?

4) For ISO 27001, are there any region-specific exclusions or control variations we should call out in the Statement of Applicability?

If you can point us to a short list of artifacts and owners, we can propose a sampling plan this week. Happy to take a 30-min sync if that's easier.

Best,
Sarah Liu
Audit Lead, AuditOps

Attachments: none in this message
From: Hiro Tanaka <hiro.tanaka@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@auditops.com>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.ai, priyom.das@redwood.ai, olga.petrov@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarify scope and regional assertions for upcoming FedRAMP/ISO readiness

Sarah —

Appreciate the clear asks. High-level answers below; Kimberly and Priyom are looped for detail and artifacts.

1) Regional assertions:
- Encryption at rest: we maintain per-region CMKs (KMS) and can produce region-scoped key metadata and access policies for us-west-2 and eu-west-1.
- Logging/retention (CloudTrail / app logs): we operate region-local ingestion with cross-region aggregation for analytics; granular retention windows are configurable per deployment. For Hosted API, primary retention is in us-west-2 by default, but we can show eu-local retention for customers on EU-enabled tenancy.
- KMS rotation/attestations and HSM usage: rotation policies are uniform, but keys are distinct per region — so we can provide per-region rotation logs.

2) Evidence locations (owners):
- S3 snapshots and environment inventories: priyom.das (will provide export recipe).
- KMS metadata & key rotation logs: olga.petrov (security infra).
- CloudTrail snapshots and aggregated audit indexes: kimberly.park (compliance).

3) SIG/CAIQ: yes — we maintain a CAIQ export and a SIG mapping by service boundary. We will scope the export to Hosted API + Dedicated + Private VPC variants.

4) ISO scope: no region-specific exclusions planned in the SoA; instead, we document boundary differences (e.g., customer-managed VPCs, on-prem deployments) as Annex items. Kimberly will provide the SoA language we're proposing.

Next steps: Kimberly will attach the scope matrix and CAIQ mapping in a follow-up. Priyom will propose the sampling windows and snapshot commands (we try to avoid full live extracts unless necessary). I can also share a short regional assertions summary PDF.

Proposed short sync: Tue Aug 25, 11:00am PT (30 min) — if that works for you, I'll send a calendar invite.

Thanks,
Hiro Tanaka
Director, Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference

--
Hiro Tanaka
Redwood Inference

Thanks — adding the artifacts and proposed sequencing below.

Attachments (stubs):
- ISO-Scope-Matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet) — control-to-controller owner map + SoA language per control.
- FedRAMP-Environment-Overview.pdf (PDF) — diagram of service boundaries + region footprint.
- Sig-CAIQ-Mapping.csv (CSV) — CAIQ answers filtered to the requested boundary.
- regional-assertions-summary.pdf (PDF) — short narrative of which assertions are region-scoped and sample artifacts to request.

Suggested evidence sequencing (minimal disruption):
1) Provide CAIQ export and SoA draft (we'll redact any customer-specific PII). (owner: kimberly.park)
2) Produce KMS metadata and key policy dump for the two regions (owner: olga.petrov) — note: we will provide metadata and rotation logs, not private key material.
3) Snapshot CloudTrail index for the sample window (owner: priyom.das) — suggested 7-day window representative of normal operations.
4) Provide configuration exports for Dedicated pools and a sanitized Network Map for Private VPC customers (owner: hiro_tanaka / infrastructure).

EdgeBank-specific note: they asked about eu-local retention. For any tenants that selected EU tenancy, we can provide region-local ingestion evidence and configuration flags.

If folks are fine, I'll attach the files to this thread (small exports). Hiro: please confirm whether we should include the EU tenancy manifests or route those via the customer's account contact.

-Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Head of Compliance
Redwood Inference

Quick practical checklist from the ops side — helps speed up the sampling work:

- Preferred sample window: 2026-08-01 to 2026-08-07 (7d) — representative weekday/weekend mix.
- CloudTrail export: will provide compressed index + manifest; we do not export raw event payloads unless specifically requested and justified.
- KMS metadata: JSON manifest with key aliases, creation/rotation timestamps, and attached IAM policy statements. (No key material.)
- S3 artifact access: we'll provide pre-signed read-only links to sanitized snapshots (redacted customer identifiers).
- Network / VPC maps: sanitized diagrams + ingress/egress ACL snippets.
- Evidence handoff: preferred: secure Drive link + short TTL pre-signed downloads (48h); if EdgeBank requires an alternate transfer, we can coordinate.

Operational constraints to note: some Private VPC customers have contractual clauses preventing public distribution of certain diagrams. We'll need to route those artifacts via EdgeBank's account admin or use a signed NDA channel.

I'll assemble the export commands and the manifest templates and attach them in the Drive link Hiro shared.

Thanks,
Priyom
Senior Infra Ops
Redwood Inference
